name: Azdomas
description: A kraul Krunstraz warrior of the Golgari who reports that Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator.

timeline.summary: Azdomas says Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator revealed by Vraska and has paid the ultimate price.
timeline.quote: Mazirek was another Bolas collaborator, revealed by Queen Vraska before her departure.

timeline.summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
timeline.quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."
